annotations.title: Screen a company against OFAC and EU sanctions lists

description:
Fuzzy name screen of a company, vessel or aircraft against the U.S. OFAC Specially Designated Nationals list and the EU consolidated financial sanctions list. Returns each possible match with its list, programs, country, aliases and a name-similarity score, plus when each list was last refreshed and links to verify on the official lists. Organisations only.
FREE tier: 10 calls per visitor per 24h. A GlobalGov plan with API access lifts the cap.
